forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+---
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: a280
+title: DemoSupport writes its recorded-session fixtures through Extras JSONLFile and index.md
+---
+## What
+The user decided (2026-10-22) that every `.jsonl` file in our packages is written and read through one Extras type, `JSONLFile`:
+- It is append-only and opens the file in append mode.
+- Each record goes out as one full line in a single unbuffered write, followed by an fsync.
+- A removal is an appended tombstone record, and the last line for a key wins.
+
+Router is also replacing each session folder's `session.json` and `facts.json` with one `index.md`: markdown with frontmatter, plus an open body. That card is 01M5HS4PZCZH6W43MM72CQEPSD on FoundationModelsRouter's board.
+
+There is no backward compatibility (ARCHITECTURE.md).
+
+This waits on the FoundationModelsExtras `JSONLFile` card, 01M5HS4C6FBNTAX30161HP0BS5 on FoundationModelsRouter's board. Bump the Extras and Router pins when they land.
+
+## Where
+- `Sources/DemoSupport/RecordedSessionsStage.swift:143` writes `sessions.jsonl` with one `write(to:)`. Append each record through JSONLFile instead.
+- The staged session folders switch to `index.md` once the Router card lands.
+
+## Subtasks
+- [ ] Write the fixtures through JSONLFile and index.md
+- [ ] `swift test` passes, zero warnings #cross-repo
\ No newline at end of file
